form_mgt_14.applicability_assessment: Private limited companies are granted specific exemptions under MCA Notification G.S.R. 464(E) dated 5th June 2015 regarding Section 179(3)(g) resolutions; qualified CS must determine whether MGT-14 filing is formally required for operational invoice delegation.

form_dir_12.statutory_basis: Section 170 of Companies Act, 2013 & Rule 17 Companies (Appointment and Qualification of Directors) Rules, 2014
form_dir_12.applicability_assessment: Applies strictly to appointment or cessation of Directors and Key Managerial Personnel (KMP); does not apply to routine operational signatory authorizations of non-KMP employees.
